headline: The Vietnam Veterans Memorial is dedicated
post_facts: Designed by Yale student Maya Lin

scenes.text: [solemnly] On this day, in nineteen eighty-two... the Vietnam Veterans Memorial was dedicated.

scenes.label: Washington, D.C.
scenes.caption: Dedication of the memorial, 1982
scenes.text: [softly] Its design came from Maya Lin, a Yale student, chosen from over fourteen hundred entries.

scenes.label: names carved in black granite
scenes.text: [solemnly] Over fifty-eight thousand names are now carved in its black granite.

scenes.label: November 1982
scenes.caption: Visitors find a name on the Wall
scenes.title: Names to touch
scenes.text: [gently] Families came to touch their loved ones' names.

scenes.title: A plain design that won hearts
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Critics first called it too plain... but that faded.

scenes.title: Have you visited the Wall?
scenes.text: [gently] Have you ever visited the Wall?
[warmly] Follow On This Day USA... for a new story from history, every day.
